description: C8: on-rails propagation through the full game loop. In FLIGHT (PhysProf-S landed on the KSC pad as active vessel), probes (one probeCoreOcto each) are spawned with ProtoVessel.CreateVesselNode + Game.AddVessel on the orbits of harness orbit_propagation cases (epoch = in-game UT at spawn instead of 0; kerbin_e081 uses sma 4,000 km because 3,000 km puts its periapsis inside Kerbin) plus a constructed Mun encounter (Kerbin orbit that enters the Mun SOI, 50 km periapsis, and leaves again). Time warp (TimeWarp.SetRate, instant) runs through 1x, 100x, 1000x, 10000x, 100000x; every 10th physics frame each vessel and the bodies Mun/Minmus are sampled. pos/vel are Orbit-frame (z-up, as Orbit stores them); world_rel = vessel.GetWorldPos3D() - mainBody.position in Unity world axes (y-up; compare with pos.xzy, offset by the vessel's rotated localCoM). SOI transitions from GameEvents.onVesselSOIChanged.
oracles: OrbitDriver.UpdateOrbit (UPDATE mode) -> Orbit.UpdateFromUT, CheckDominantBody -> OnRailsSOITransition (UtilMath.BSPSolver), Planetarium time under TimeWarp

provenance.decimal_format: normalized from _hex by harness/captures/tools/normalize.py (harness ExactNumber.FormatFloat/FormatDouble on .NET Framework ToString G6..G9 / G15..G17)

tables.description: Per sample frame: Planetarium.Zup (the CelestialFrame Orbit uses for getRelativePositionAtUT/pos: relpos = Zup.WorldToLocal(inertial z-up vector)) and the rotating-frame angle. Zup follows Planetarium.inverseRotAngle, which tracks Kerbin's rotation while FlightGlobals.RefFrameIsRotating (active vessel below inverseRotThresholdAltitude).
